subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam influences young minds.

options.text: Young minds get influenced by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam
Young minds were influenced by the speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam.
Young minds are influenced by the speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam.
The speech of Dr. APJ Adul Kalam is very influencing.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Young minds are influenced by the speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice.
 
• As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V1(s/es) + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ is/am/are + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *She shows them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Some rare photographs are shown by her. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is **'speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam.****'**​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'young minds.'
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Influences' will be changed into 'are influenced.'
 
• The preposition "by" is used to indicate who is performing the action (in this case, **"speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam"**).
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.

 ​

Correct sentence:* Young minds are influenced by the speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam*.
